instruction.thesis: The BTC put-call exhaustion/reversal thesis (H-069) required a P/C ratio spike above 1.0 during consolidation to signal call unwind exhaustion. The btc_ibit_pc_ratio has since normalized from the entry spike back to 0.736, which is the expected thesis completion signal — but BTC spot has not bounced; it has drifted lower from 76,989 to 76,710 (-0.36%). The btc_spot is now at the 29th percentile of its 24h range and the 5th percentile of its 7d range, showing continued weakness rather than reversal. Simultaneously, BTC PM IV has spiked dramatically from 35.5% to 46.3% (+2.1σ), which is inconsistent with a calm consolidation bounce setup and suggests the market is pricing in a larger directional move. The setup family (btc_put_call_exhaustion_reversal) has 0/4 clean live trade wins with avg P&L of -2.05%, confirming the thesis is not working. With 46h remaining and the stop at -1.5%, the risk/reward is unfavorable — closing to preserve capital.
